reason: cxf.version property updated to 4.2.2.vendor-00001 (both governed artifacts available at that version); the replay-enabling fallback in AuditedCodeDataProvider.removeCodeGrant was changed to return null so the library fix is not bypassed.
strategy_reason: Both artifacts governed by <cxf.version> (cxf-spring-boot-starter-jaxrs and cxf-rt-rs-security-oauth2) are published at 4.2.2.vendor-00001, so the shared property declaration could be moved without leaving either unresolvable.

source_changes.what: Changed the fallback in removeCodeGrant from 'return audited.get(code)' to 'return null'.
source_changes.why: The fixed library makes removeCodeGrant return null on a second call for the same code. The previous fallback re-served the grant from the audit map, completely bypassing the fix and re-enabling unlimited code replay in violation of RFC 6749 §4.1.2.
